intro: Lesson 20: 1.7 Opponents, prisoners and other communities; the hadith on obeying those in authority. Plan or write in each box.

parts.text: Point 1: obedience is a duty. Develop: 'in what he likes and dislikes', so society stays stable. Point 2: it has a limit. Develop: 'if commanded to disobey Allah, there is no listening and no obeying': Allah's law is above any ruler.
